meta.title: 自我介绍别复述简历｜四步讲好我是谁
meta.title_en: Stop Repeating Your Resume: A Four-Step Story for Self-Introductions

scenes.context: 讲者指出自我介绍的最大误区是把简历复述一遍，近九成学员讲不好自我介绍。
sentences: 开场的自我介绍太重要了，讲不好就会搞砸第一印象。
Your opening self-introduction matters so much—botch it and you've ruined the first impression.
搞砸：botch
自我介绍最大的误区，就是把简历简单的再复述一遍。
The biggest mistake is simply reciting your resume all over again.
复述一遍：recite all over again
如果等于复述简历，那面试官直接看简历就好了。
If it's just a resume recital, the interviewer could simply read your resume instead.
直接看简历：simply read your resume
paraphrase: 复述简历 → 零信息增量
Reciting your resume adds zero new information.
自我介绍 = 印象管理的开场
Your intro is the opening move of impression management.
scenes.speak: Your opening self-introduction matters so much—botch it and you've ruined the first impression. The biggest mistake is simply reciting your resume all over again. If it's just a resume recital, the interviewer could simply read your resume instead.

scenes.title_en: Why Interviewers Ask for an Intro
scenes.context: 讲者说明面试官要自我介绍的真正目的：热身与建立第一印象。
sentences: 面试官要你自我介绍的目的有两个。
Interviewers ask for a self-introduction for two reasons.
目的有两个：two reasons
一是面试热身，把双方拉到面试的风格里面去。
First, to warm up and set the tone of the interview.
面试热身：warm up
二是通过你的自我介绍，建立对你的第一印象。
Second, to form a first impression of you based on your intro.
第一印象：first impression
paraphrase: 热身 → 决定对话的节奏
Warm-up sets the rhythm of the conversation.
第一印象 → 决定听下去的意愿
First impressions decide whether they want to keep listening.
scenes.speak: Interviewers ask for a self-introduction for two reasons. First, to warm up and set the tone of the interview. Second, to form a first impression of you based on your intro.

scenes.context: 讲者给出抓住面试官注意力的四步结构：分阶段、讲产出、总结优势、说清诉求。
sentences: 讲好一个生动的、关于我是谁的故事，才能抓住面试官注意力。
A vivid story about who you are is what grabs the interviewer's attention.
抓住注意力：grab attention
把履历分成几个阶段，讲每个阶段的重要产出和个人成长。
Break your career into stages, then highlight the key results and personal growth in each.
重要产出：key results
总结核心优势，并讲清楚你的求职诉求。
Summarize your core strengths, and make your job-seeking motivation clear.
求职诉求：job-seeking motivation
paraphrase: 四步 = 故事的四个段落
The four steps are the four paragraphs of your story.
好自我介绍 → 让人想继续了解
A good intro makes them want to learn more about you.
scenes.speak: A vivid story about who you are is what grabs the interviewer's attention. Break your career into stages, then highlight the key results and personal growth in each. Summarize your core strengths, and make your job-seeking motivation clear.

practice: Let me break my career into three stages.
In that role, my key results included...
To sum up, my core strengths are experience, skills, and overall judgment.
I left my last job to grow, and now I'm looking for a role in...
pitfalls: ✕ 直译腔：My self-introduction is to recite the resume.
✓ 地道说法：I'm not here to recite my resume.
recite 用于正式场合，口语用 walk through / repeat。
✕ 直译腔：Grab the interviewer's attention fast.
✓ 地道说法：Hook the interviewer within the first minute.
hook 更口语，表达「抓住注意力」。
✓ 地道说法：Highlight my key results in each stage.
✓ 地道说法：My motivation for this role is...
求职诉求用 motivation，不是 appeal。
shifts: 自我介绍=把简历背一遍
自我介绍=讲我是谁的故事
追求短时间抓住注意力
分阶段讲产出、总结优势、说清诉求
footer_notes: ASR 校正：原文「面试运热」按语境校正为「面试热身」，「太动摇了」校正为「太重要了」。场景/句子朗读使用 edge-tts，单词发音使用浏览器 Web Speech API。
